msg: Root <Faktura> must carry the FA(3) namespace xmlns="http://crd.gov.pl/wzor/2025/06/25/13775/". Any other CRD template is an FA(2)-era namespace and KSeF rejects the document.
KodFormularza must have kodSystemowy="FA (3)" - with one space before the bracket.
KodFormularza must have wersjaSchemy="1-0E" for the FA(3) structure.
<DataWytworzeniaFa> is xs:dateTime, not a date: use 2026-09-14T09:12:31Z form.
<NIP> must be exactly 10 digits - no PL prefix, no dashes, no spaces.
<KodWaluty> must be a 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as PLN or EUR.
<P_1> (issue date) must be ISO yyyy-mm-dd, not the Polish dd.mm.yyyy form.
<P_2> (invoice number) must be present and non-empty.
<RodzajFaktury> must be one of VAT, KOR, ZAL, ROZ, UPR, KOR_ZAL, KOR_ROZ.
Amounts use a dot decimal separator. A Polish locale comma makes the amount unparseable for KSeF.
Amounts carry no thousands separator and no spaces - digits and one dot only.
The XML declaration must say encoding="UTF-8"; Polish diacritics break under any other encoding.
<Adnotacje> must carry the P_16, P_17, P_18 and P_18A flags, each 1 or 2.
A correction invoice must identify the invoice it corrects in <DaneFaKorygowanej>.
Placeholder value left in the document - a generated sample identifier, not real party data.
Podmiot1 (seller) and Podmiot2 (buyer) each need identification with a non-empty <Nazwa> or a surname.
